svg.title: Worker execution
svg.desc: This is an execution overview. Startup, resource readiness and Linear acknowledgement remain separate observations even though one decision checks that all are present. Detailed guard and recovery rules follow the diagrams.

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 1. Tool reads queued work or authorized resume

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 2. Do dependencies, holds and limits allow work?

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 3. Tool reserves resources and starts the worker

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 4. Are startup, resources and In Progress confirmed?

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 5. Tool grants work and shows Running

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 6. Worker reports progress and results to the lead

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 7. Lead verifies the result or interruption

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 8. CLI shows the blocked, failed or unknown condition

g.data-value: Eligibility, owned resources, confirmed startup and supervised results.
g.text: Eligibility, owned resources, confirmed startup and supervised results.
